name: memory_jvm
description: Diagnostic workflow for high memory usage, node memory consumption, JVM CPU load, and JVM Heap OutOfMemory.

steps.goal: Scan logs for Full GC pauses, OutOfMemoryError, and heap allocation failures.
Inspect container and node memory metrics (working set, heap utilization).
Verify whether memory continuously rises without recovery, indicating a leak.
Correlate JVM stop-the-world GC pauses with elevated trace span latency.

rules: Routine Young GC ('GC Allocation Failure') is normal JVM operation and not an incident.
Full GC or OutOfMemory in logs strongly corroborates memory saturation.
Root cause occurrence time corresponds to the initial surge in heap/memory, not the crash moment.
